people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
translations.bsb: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
translations.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
translations.asv: And Mary arose in these days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah;
